## Learning about desmoothing

Appraisal-based series are smoothed by partial adjustment. Classical methods invert the smoothing after the fact.

- Geltner (1991, 1993): partial-adjustment model and AR(1) desmoothing formula.
- Getmansky, Lo & Makarov (2004): MA(k) smoothing profile.

This project writes the smoothing as the observation equation of a state-space model instead of inverting a finished index.

## Looking at the data

Cleaned Class 1 rolls live in `data/cleaned/class1_YYYY.csv`.

```{r}
#| echo: true
library(tidyverse)

# Example: load one year
d <- read_csv("../data/cleaned/class1_2009.csv")
glimpse(d)
```

## The method

Latent price $P_t$ evolves as a random walk. The uncapped appraisal is a partial adjustment of that price. The roll records the censored version $A_t = \min(A_t^*, c_t)$. Land value and sparse sales identify $P_t$.
